description: Emulator-independent signatures: Windows exit codes and common loader errors.

rules.title: A required runtime library is missing
rules.probableCause: The Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtime (x64) is missing or outdated, or the emulator folder is incomplete.
manual: Install the latest Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64) from https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe.

rules.title: This emulator build is not compatible with your CPU
rules.probableCause: The emulator was built for CPU instructions (for example AVX2) that your processor does not support.
manual: Reinstall the emulator; OmniPC selects a build that matches your CPU.

rules.title: The emulator crashed
rules.probableCause: Crashes like this are most often caused by the graphics renderer or driver, a corrupt shader cache, or a bad game dump. The exit code alone cannot tell which.
manual: Try a different renderer for this game (Game > Settings > Renderer).
If only one game crashes, verify the game file.

rules.title: A system component failed to start
rules.probableCause: A DLL failed to initialise. This is commonly caused by graphics driver problems or security software blocking the emulator.
manual: If you use third-party antivirus, allow the OmniPC Emulators folder.

rules.title: Vulkan is not available
rules.probableCause: The Vulkan renderer is selected but no working Vulkan driver is installed.
manual: Install the latest graphics driver from your GPU vendor, or use a Direct3D renderer.
